reviews.text: A great little tool, which I typically use to gently exfoliate my nose. It doesn't irritate my skin and does a great job at removing dry skin around my nose, which I experience due to allergies.
reviews.zh: 呢件小工具好實用，我通常用佢輕輕咁幫鼻去角質。唔會刺激皮膚，而且對於因為敏感而鼻周圍出現嘅乾皮，去除效果好好。

reviews.text: This is my second purchase so I can keep one in every bathroom. I love this dual brush for any wash-off face mask, and I use the other end to rinse them off.
reviews.zh: 呢個已經係我第二次回購，等我可以每個浴室都放一支。對於所有清洗式面膜，呢支雙頭刷我都好鍾意，另一端我會用嚟沖洗面膜。

reviews.text: I really like this tool, it helps get sebum and those hard white heads out! I use it at least once - three times a week when I am double cleansing. I find that if I use it every day -- because I have no self control, I scrub too hard but that is no fault to the tool, its user error lol.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢件工具，佢可以幫我清出皮脂同埋啲硬硬嘅白頭！我每星期用一至三次，都係喺雙重清潔嘅時候用。不過如果日日用嘅話——因為我自制力差，會捽得太用力，但呢個唔關工具事，係我自己用得唔好，哈哈。

reviews.text: It’s good but nothing special. It does it works but probably doesn’t really a necessity.
reviews.zh: 好係好嘅，但冇乜特別。佢係做到嘢，但未必真係必需品。

reviews.text: this brush thing is kind of handy for giving your skin a mini deep clean using the bumpy side to massage away dead skin and blackheads and then flipping it to spread masks evenly. it’s soft, easy to rinse off, and feels more hygienic than using hands. not a must-have but nice if you like keeping everything neat during cleansing.
reviews.zh: 呢件刷具幾好用，可以用凸點嗰邊幫皮膚做個迷你深層清潔，推走死皮同黑頭，再反轉另一邊均勻咁塗面膜。刷毛好柔軟，容易沖洗，仲比用手更加衛生。唔算必買嘅嘢，但如果你鍾意清潔時所有嘢都整整齊齊，佢就幾啱用。

reviews.text: The ISLO Dual Clean Brush is one of those rare skincare tools that balances effectiveness with gentleness. The soft silicone bristles on one side are perfect for a daily deep cleanse without irritating the skin, while the textured side helps boost circulation and gives a mild exfoliation that feels more like a mini massage than a scrub.
reviews.zh: ISLO 雙效清潔刷係一款罕見嘅護膚工具，能夠兼顧效果同溫和度。一邊嘅柔軟矽膠刷毛非常適合每日深層清潔，又唔會刺激皮膚；而另一邊嘅凹凸面可以促進血液循環，帶嚟溫和嘅去角質效果，感覺比較似迷你按摩多過磨砂。

reviews.text: Cumple su función!! Me gusta porque por un lado me puedo dar masajes en el teatro y por el otro lado lo limpio. Me ayuda a remover el maquillaje y me mantiene el área de la nariz mucho más limpia disminuyendo las espinillas negras.
reviews.zh: 做到佢嘅功用！！我鍾意因為一邊可以幫我按摩面部，另外一邊可以清潔。佢可以幫我卸妝，而且可以保持鼻周圍乾淨好多，減少黑頭。

reviews.text:
브링그린의 티트리시카 포어 클레이 팩을 바르고 지울 때 사용하는 중. Used it to apply and wipe off Bring Green Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack.
결론은 마스크팩을 바를때 말랑말랑 밴딩이 잘되니까 얇게 발리고 두텁게 바르기 힘들었음. Because it is bendy it applies thinly and it wasn't easy to apply a thick layer.
하지만 지울 때는 상당히 편했는데 짧은 돌기로 굳은 팩을 녹이고 말랑한 솔로 간편하게 잘 지워졌다. However this product worked very well when it came to washing off the clay pack once it dried. I used the short bumpy side to soften the dried clay and used the softer bristle side to wipe off the residue while massaging gently. 
가끔 피곤하면 오일 클렌져로 마사지할때 그냥 두 손 안쓰고 이걸로 문지름. Sometimes I just use the soft bristle side to melt my makeup when I'm too tired and can't be bothered to use both of my hands to massage my face using an oil cleanser.
말랑한것과는 별개로 너무 오랜시간 힘써서 문지르는 것은 금물. Try not to apply too much pressure and over use it on your skin.
reviews.zh:
我喺塗同抹走 Bring Green 茶樹積雪草毛孔泥膜嘅時候用呢件工具。
結論係，塗面膜嗰陣因為佢軟軟哋、好有彈性，所以上得好薄，反而好難塗厚。
不過抹走嘅時候就相當方便，可以用短凸點嗰邊將乾硬嘅面膜軟化，再用柔軟嘅刷毛一邊輕輕按摩一邊輕鬆抹走。
有時攰嘅時候用卸妝油按摩，我就唔使兩隻手，用佢嚟擦就得。
但係無論佢幾柔軟都好，長時間大力磨擦係唔得嘅。唔好對皮膚施加太大壓力或者過度使用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
